input.title: Use the account's local date in export file names
input.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

formatExportFilename builds the date suffix with at.toISOString().slice(0, 10), which is always UTC, so an export made in the evening in a timezone behind UTC gets tomorrow's date. It should compute the date using the account's (or report's) local timezone instead of UTC, for both on-demand exports (src/api/reports.ts) and scheduled ones (src/export/scheduler.ts).

input.title: Keep the "(copy)" suffix when duplicating a long report name
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

In the POST /reports/:id/duplicate handler, the new name is built as truncate(`${source.name} (copy)`, MAX_NAME_LENGTH). When source.name is close to the 120-character limit, truncate() cuts into the appended " (copy)" text and replaces the tail with "...", so the copy's name looks identical to the original. The name should instead truncate source.name first, leaving room to always append " (copy)".

input.title: Keep non-Latin letters in export file names
input.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() normalizes to NFKD, strips combining marks, then drops everything outside [a-z0-9] with replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-"), which removes Greek and Cyrillic letters entirely (while accented Latin letters survive via decomposition). Report names in those scripts should keep their own letters in the generated file name rather than collapsing to just "report".

input.title: Clear the previous upload error when a new file is chosen
input.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The file input's onChange handler only calls setFile; it never clears the `problem` state from a previous failed upload, so the old error (and row number) stays visible under the form until the user clicks Upload again. The onChange handler should also call setProblem(null) when a new file is selected.

label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts

formatExportFilename() computes the date suffix from at.toISOString().slice(0,10), which is always UTC. For a timezone behind UTC (like Los Angeles), an evening export's UTC date is already the next calendar day, so the file name gets tomorrow's date. This affects both on-demand exports and the scheduled emails. The fix is to compute the date in the relevant local timezone rather than UTC.

label: question
file: none

Amounts are not stored as floating point. src/util/money.ts parses each amount into an integer number of minor units (parseAmount) and all arithmetic (totals, export formatting) is done on those integers, so there's no floating-point rounding error. minorDigits() determines how many minor units a currency uses: 2 for most currencies, 0 for zero-decimal currencies like JPY, ISK, KRW, etc. (see the ZERO_DECIMAL set), so yen amounts are stored and totalled as whole units rather than being divided into nonexistent cents.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts

The duplicate handler builds the new name with truncate(`${source.name} (copy)`, MAX_NAME_LENGTH). When source.name is near the 120-character limit, truncate() cuts into the appended " (copy)" text and replaces the tail with "...", so the two reports' names look identical. The name should be built by truncating source.name first and always appending " (copy)" afterward.

label: feature
file: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() normalizes to NFKD and strips combining marks (so accented Latin letters decompose and survive), but then replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-") drops any character outside plain ASCII letters/digits, which removes Greek and Cyrillic letters entirely, leaving an empty slug that falls back to "report". Supporting other scripts in export file names means widening that allowed character set (or transliterating) instead of discarding everything non-Latin.

text:
All five issues have been triaged:

1. **issue-4424** — `bug`, file `src/exportUtils.ts` — `formatExportFilename` uses UTC instead of local time for the date suffix. PR pr-38 opened.
2. **issue-4426** — `question`, file `none` — Confirmed amounts are stored as integer minor units (not floats), with zero-decimal currency handling in `src/util/money.ts`. No PR needed.
3. **issue-4429** — `bug`, file `src/api/reports.ts` — `truncate()` is applied after appending " (copy)", so long names lose that suffix. PR pr-39 opened.
4. **issue-4431** — `feature`, file `src/util/strings.ts` — `slugify()` strips all non-Latin characters, erasing Greek/Cyrillic report names. PR pr-40 opened.
5. **issue-4434** — `bug`, file `src/components/UploadForm.tsx` — the file picker's `onChange` never clears the previous error state. PR pr-41 opened.

Each received its label, a pull request where applicable, and exactly one triage comment.
